correctness.rationale: Direct quotient differentiation cancels common crowding; monotonicity of annual Q(q)/q and its endpoint limits give a unique repelling fixed ratio. Separation gives an explicit slope for C≠0 and C=0. The exact logistic annual restriction to the ray proves convergence and one contracting radial eigenvalue. Away from the ray, reciprocal affine recurrences prove the two global axial limits; the unstable transverse eigenvalue is Q_prime(q*)>1. Three numerical checks reproduce the formula to approximately 10^-14, but universal conclusions use the proof.
